newsitem.title: USA: IDEX sees record Q4, FY96 results.
newsitem.headline: IDEX sees record Q4, FY96 results.

text.p: IDEX Corp said Tuesday it expects to report record sales, net income and earnings per share for the fourth quarter and the full-year 1996.
Earlier, it reported third quarter income of $0.60 a share, up from $0.54 a year ago. Sales for the quarter were $140.9 million, up from $116.8 million a year ago.
Third quarter net sales were $140.9 million, up 21 percent from $116.8 million.

"As expected, we were able to achieve nice growth in earnings in the third quarter," Donald Boyce, chairman, said in a statement. "With our customarily small backlogs of about one-and-a-half months' sales, near-term sales volume hinges on the incoming order pace. Based on current activity levels, we continue to expect that new records will be achieved in sales, net income and earnings per share for the fourth quarter and for the full year 1996."

IDEX said the third quarter results include two months of activity for Fluid Management, which was acquired in late July, and a full quarter of activity for Lukas Hydraulik, acquired in the fourth quarter of last year.

"Without these acquisitions, overall sales would have been up by about three percent; however, incoming orders in our base businesses were up nine percent over the third quarter of last year," Boyce said.

In the third quarter, the Fluid Handling Group accounted for 76 percent of sales and 78 percent of profits, IDEX said. The Industrial Products Group contributed 24 percent of sales and 22 percent of profits.
International sales rose to 41 percent of total in the third quarter, up from 35 percent of sales in the year-ago period.
